description: RevenueDot's MIT fork of RevenueCat's Flutter SDK, pointed at RevenueDot, the open-source RevenueCat alternative for in-app purchases and subscriptions.
rules: Install as a git dependency on https://github.com/revenuedot/purchases-flutter with a `ref` of the upstream version plus -revenuedot. The pub.dev names purchases_flutter and purchases_ui_flutter belong to RevenueCat.
The package names stay purchases_flutter and purchases_ui_flutter, so `import 'package:purchases_flutter/purchases_flutter.dart';` keeps working.
RevenueDot Cloud (https://api.revenuedot.app) is the default API host. For a self-hosted server, call `await Purchases.setProxyURL('https://revenuedot.example.com')` before `Purchases.configure`.
Pass each app's public key from the RevenueDot dashboard to `PurchasesConfiguration`: appl_ for iOS and goog_ for Android.
